integrity: Full finite state-and-transition certificate and two separately implemented exhaustive verification programs; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact computational theorem for one explicitly defined finite graph and shortest eight-cycle flips only; no infinite extension, priority guarantee or external independent audit. Scalar perfect-matching count and two-factor type counts were previously known and are credited.
title: Shortest-cycle perfect-matching flips of the Tutte–Coxeter graph
